name: Calloway Urban Walker
description: A clean, low-profile walking shoe with a slightly elevated heel and padded collar. Available in slate, tan, and navy. Looks professional enough for an office, comfortable enough for a two-hour commute. The go-to for Tier 3 workers who spend their day on their feet.
functionality: Moisture-wicking insole liner. Passive arch-support insert. No active tech.
what_it_says: You're practical and presentable. You've thought about your feet.
story_hooks: The insole has a small hidden pocket — previous owner used it to stash a folded note.
A sales rep at Calloway swears this model hasn't changed in forty years. They're right.
